name: Tofu Portobello Melts with Mixed Greens & Salsa Verde Vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 caps portobello mushrooms
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills; discard stems and gills.

Place mushrooms, stem-side down, onto a baking sheet pan and season with oil, salt, and pepper; turn mushrooms over. Place in the oven, and bake until tender, about 10 minutes. When the mushrooms are done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and shallot. Mince capers. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
½ shallot
1 tbsp capers
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice the tofu.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu, soy sauce, and Italian seasoning. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp soy sauce
¾ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, grate cheeses, combine in a small bowl, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ (227 g) block mozzarella cheese
28 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince additional garlic. Mince sun-dried tomatoes.
Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, tomato sauce, and salt to the skillet with the tofu. Continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (213 ml) can tomato sauce
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Set oven to broil on high.

When the mushrooms are cool enough to handle, carefully lift each cap with a spatula and tip the juices out into the sink; return mushrooms, stem-side up, to the baking sheet pan. Blot the inside of each cap with a paper towel before filling.
Divide half the cheese between the mushrooms, then add the tofu mixture. Cover with remaining cheese and sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Return to the oven and broil until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add parsley and spring mix to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide tofu mushroom melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!
